gc.portalschutz.title: Portal guard
gc.portalschutz.short: Asks before a portal is renamed and remembers its previous name.
gc.portalschutz.body:
The mod adds the [[gc.portalschutz.portalguard|portal name guard]]: a confirmation before renaming, no connections broken by unchanged names, and a [[gc.portalschutz.previous|previous name]] to restore. It belongs to the **GC Client** package ([[gc.kern.stufe|level]] 1 “Very vanilla”), runs only on your side and works on every server.

Set it up in the [[gc.option|GC Option menu]]; the whole mod can be switched off on the [[gc.modswitch|Mods]] tab.

gc.portalschutz.portalguard.title: Portal name guard
gc.portalschutz.portalguard.short: Confirmation before every portal rename; confirming an unchanged name no longer breaks a connection.
gc.portalschutz.portalguard.body:
In Valheim, merely confirming the rename dialog with an unchanged name breaks the connection, and an accidental E and Enter overwrites the name. With the guard an unchanged confirmation does nothing, and a [[gc.portalschutz.portalguard_confirm|confirmation]] appears before every real rename of a named portal. Empty names stay allowed like in vanilla, since portals without a name connect too.

The portal remembers its [[gc.portalschutz.previous|previous name]]; the [[gc.portalschutz.portalguard_key|key]] brings it back.

gc.portalschutz.previous.title: Previous name
gc.portalschutz.previous.short: The name a portal had before its last rename; it can be restored.
gc.portalschutz.previous.body:
With every rename the portal remembers its old name, and its hover text shows it. Hold the [[gc.portalschutz.portalguard_key|key]] (currently {gc_portalschutz_portalguard_key}) and use the portal: a confirmation asks whether it should carry that name again.

With Guilds_Vehicle, Shift+E at the portal opens its guild menu; then you restore the old name from the name list while renaming.

gc.portalschutz.portalguard_confirm.title: Ask before renaming
gc.portalschutz.portalguard_confirm.short: Confirmation “rename from X to Y?” before a named portal gets a new name.
gc.portalschutz.portalguard_confirm.body: The confirmation warns that portals with the old name lose their connection. It only appears for portals that already have a name; a click in the list of the Portal names mod does not ask. Off: renaming without confirmation, while unchanged confirmations still do nothing.

gc.portalschutz.portalguard_key.title: Key: restore the old name
gc.portalschutz.portalguard_key.short: Hold this key and use the portal: you are asked whether it should carry its previous name again.
gc.portalschutz.portalguard_key.body: Currently {gc_portalschutz_portalguard_key} (default Shift, so Shift+E). E alone still opens the rename dialog. If the portal has no [[gc.portalschutz.previous|previous name]], a message says so; in someone else's ward its lock applies as usual.
